item.title: Yemen's Houthis Say Carried Out Drone Strike on Saudi Aramco's Refinery in Jazan
item.summary: BEIRUT (Sputnik) - Yemen's Ansar Allah movement, also known as the Houthis, carried out a drone attack on Saudi Aramco's oil refinery in Jazan in southwestern Saudi Arabia, Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said on Sunday.
